recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to detailed SNOMED CT implicit ConceptMap URL patterns should be handled in HL7 Terminology/UTG; only generic FHIR ConceptMap behavior belongs in core ConceptMap notes.
issue_request: FHIR-12390 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request asking FHIR to expose SNOMED CT Simple Map and Association Reference Set content as implicit ConceptMaps, including fhir_cm URL patterns and association relationship mappings.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in git-svn commit 9b6379be0c869eb42a77321992b93aa7aa30874a, SVN revision 10491, which added an 'Implicit Concept Maps' section to the old source/snomedct.html page. The Jira comment records the same SVN revision.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later moved the Using external code systems pages from FHIR core to HL7 Terminology and deleted source/snomedct.html, leaving only source/snomedct-usage.html as a core usage summary. The combined branch already contains a FHIR-35933 audit commit. FHIR-38110 and FHIR-39266 later added and refined the active ConceptMap resource notes so core explains implicit concept map URI behavior and links to the THO SNOMED CT implicit ConceptMap page, which now carries the detailed Association Reference Set, Simple Map Reference Set, and ?fhir_cm=[sctid] template guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because re-adding or duplicating the old SNOMED CT page in core would conflict with the later migration to THO and create maintenance drift.
